title: Vertebrae Necklace
shoot_prompt: A high-fashion commercial luxury jewelry 3x3 contact sheet featuring the Vertebrae Necklace. Canvas layout: Exactly 9 vertical 3:4 portrait vignette frames arranged in a 3x3 grid, edge-to-edge full bleed, separated by crisp 1.5px solid white #FFFFFF borders. Studio Environment: Standardized neutral cyclorama backdrop in matte grey #EFEFEF, clean minimal stone surface with subtle soft contact shadows. Coherent 5500K softbox illumination, Hasselblad H6D-100c medium format clarity, f/8 depth of field. Product Specifics: Monumental anatomical statement necklace in 316L surgical stainless steel constructed from 16 individually cast, hinged cervical vertebrae links ending in a dramatic spine drop tail. Mode: SINGLE_ITEM. Row 1 (Packshot Hero): Cell 1 (Front Hero): Frontal eye-level packshot of the Vertebrae necklace arranged in a curved cervical arc on stone surface, displaying organic spinal symmetry. Cell 2 (3/4 Perspective): Three-quarter view showing the protruding spinous process spurs and articulated joint interlocks. Cell 3 (Side Profile): Lateral view showing the spinal curve and flex of the individual bone segments. Row 2 (Technical Details): Cell 4 (Overhead Flat Lay): Direct top-down flat lay on #EFEFEF surface showing the fluid serpentine layout of the complete 16-link chain. Cell 5 (Optical Macro): Extreme macro view capturing the precision hinge pins connecting two spinal segments, showing satin steel brushing. Cell 6 (Mechanical Detail): Technical macro focus on the concealed bone-interlock clasp mechanism seamlessly hidden inside the terminal vertebra. Row 3 (Editorial On-Model Context): Cell 7 (Editorial Portrait): Frontal high-fashion editorial portrait of a model wearing the Vertebrae choker collar tightly framing the neck, dark avant-garde styling. Cell 8 (Intimate Micro-Crop): Close-up crop at the suprasternal notch and clavicle bones, showing the spinal drop resting directly along the center of the chest. Cell 9 (Dynamic Lifestyle): 3/4 editorial styling shot displaying how the necklace flexes organically with neck movement. Strict Invariant: ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT, NO LABELS, NO NUMBERS, NO WATERMARKS, NO GRAPHICS. Pure raw commercial photography only.
